      "reasoning":"A newly registered account shipping to its home could legitimately share that address with other household members. The address is too recently registered for the policy's household exception."

  "memo":"R08 holds because three accounts use the shipping address. Although it is the account's home, its recent registration prevents the household exception. Linkage is the only adverse family; no other rule holds, and no earlier outcome settles the order. Legitimate household sharing remains plausible, while a synthetic identity is possible but unproven. No installments were due, so non-payment cannot support this recommendation. With no completed checks, recommend needs_check under FP-2 §6.6(b), implemented as a hold with id_check. That check establishes identity and card control; a pass clears the order under §5.3(a). The order has not shipped."
